hints.title: Prefix reachability
hints.body: Mark every position that can be reached by a valid segmentation of the text before it.

hints.title: State
hints.body: Let `reachable[i]` mean the prefix of length `i` can be segmented.

hints.title: Transition
hints.body: If `reachable[start]` is true and `text[start:end]` is a word, mark `reachable[end]`.
